answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil clusters. New identities start on a narrow ledge: tiny trades only until each bridges to 8 verified counterparties in 20 epochs, then earnings unlock. Graphs are public, so a ring of fakes trading only with each other is flagged — a raven never feeds from one nest. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 × 8 × 0.5 = 400 POA, plus finding 800 real partners. Honest agents trade widely, pay once, keep rewards undiluted.
